annotations.title: Put a rule on the line rider

description: Add a rule the owner set for this line: brand, naming, tone, forbidden words, output language, a dated owner decision or what counts as proof. SHELL carries the rider on every start, heaviest rule first. A decision needs scope, said_at and the owner's quote; a newer decision on the same scope retires the older one. Never put secrets in a rule.

body.description: The rule. forbidden: words separated by commas; naming: "wrong => right" per line; brand: "own: …" and "foreign: …" lines; language: ISO code first (pl, en).

kind.description: Rule kind from the mot catalog: brand, naming, tone, forbidden, language, decision, proof.

quote.description: decision only: the owner's words, quoted.

said_at.description: decision only: when the owner said it (ISO 8601).

scope.description: decision only: what the decision is about. A newer decision on the same scope wins.

weight.description: Heavier rules come first in SHELL (0..1000, default 100).

name: line_rider_put
